properties.content:

Nearest City: Galva, IA
Incident Type: CONTINUOUS
Material: AMMONIA, ANHYDROUS
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: AIR LIQUIDE INDUSTRIAL US L.P.
Skytruth Analysis
ON APR 24,2008 THE AMMONIA CONDENSER WAS SHUT DOWN DUE TO AN ODOR THAT WAS DETECTED IN A ROUTINE INVESTIGATION. THE SOURCE OF THE LEAK WAS IDENTIFIED AND BLOCKED AND THAT COIL WAS TAKEN OUT OF SERVICE. BASED ON PRELIMINARY CALCULATIONS THE LEAK WAS BELOW 89 LBS WITHIN A 24 HOUR PERIOD AND THE REMAINING COIL WAS RESTARTED. IN AN AUDIT OF THE AMMONIA CONDENSER ON JULY 1,2008 IT WAS DETERMINED THAT THE AMOUNT OF THE PAST AMMONIA RELEASE MAY HAVE TOTALED 443 POUNDS PER DAY. THE UNIT WAS ALREADY SHUT DOWN FOR MAINTENANCE WHEN THE REVISED EMISSION AMOUNTS WERE DISCOVERED. THE REMAINING COIL WAS ISOLATED AND THE AMMONIA WAS EVACUATED FROM THE SYSTEM.

CALLER IS REPORTING THAT ON THE 21ST OF THIS MONTH THEY WERE NOTIFIED THAT AN INFECTIOUS PACKAGE WAS MISSING. THE PACKAGE WAS PICKED UP ON JUNE 5 IN SEATTLE, WA AND WAS SUPPOSE TO BE DELIVERED TO THE ALASKA PUBLIC HEALTH DEPARTMENT IN ANCHORAGE, AK BY THE 6TH OF JUNE. DUE TO ERRORS ON THE SHIPPING PAPERS, THE PACKAGE WAS STOPPED AT THE LAX GATEWAY AND PUT ON A PLANE HEADED BACK TO SEATTLE, WA. THE DESCRIPTION OF THE PACKAGE IS AS FOLLOWS: A WHITE BOX MEASURING 8" X 9"X 11". PREPRINTED AS QUEST DIAGNOSTICS IN BLACK INK. ONE SIDE HAS THE UN # 2814- INFECTIOUS SUBSTANCE EFFECTING HUMANS. TECHNICAL NAME- PATHOGENIC BACTERIA, PATHOGENIC FUNGUS-SALMONELLA. ON THE OTHER SIDE IS A COMPETENT AUTHORITY LETTER. TOP OF THE BOX SAYS REFRIGERATED.
